description: Per-paper characterization profile: empirical envelope, failure modes, deviations from paper, parameter sensitivity. This is the file that hackathon graders read to assign result_fidelity and output_coverage scores.

deviations_from_paper.description: Quantitative comparison of reproduction outputs against the paper's reported values. THIS IS THE PRIMARY GRADING SIGNAL — every paper target should appear here.

actual_value.description: What the reproduction produced. Number, array, object, or string depending on metric.

evidence_artifact.description: Artifact id (from execution.artifacts[].id) backing this deviation.

explanation.description: Human-readable rationale, especially for non-trivial metrics.

metric.description: PREFER NUMERICAL METRICS over visual ones. ssim only acceptable when no scalar/array result is recoverable; max contribution capped at 0.3 in result_fidelity. Use relative_error for scalars, rmse / l2_relative_norm for arrays/curves, pearson_r for correlation-shaped claims, ks_statistic / kl_divergence for distributions, physical_consistency for domain-rule checks (energy conservation, mass balance, etc.).

reference_value.description: What the paper reports. Same shape as actual_value.

score.description: Normalised match score derived from metric. 1.0 = matches paper exactly; 0.0 = unrelated. See ARM_PROTOCOL_REFERENCE.md §Metric Score Derivation for per-metric formulas.

target.description: Logical name matching expected_outputs[*].name (e.g. 'Figure 2a', 'Table 1 row 3', 'CIFAR-10 accuracy').

tolerance.description: Threshold below which score=1.0 (interpretation depends on metric).

verifier_script.description: Optional path to a script (relative to bundle root) that recomputes score from artifact + reference. Required when metric='custom' or 'physical_consistency'.

envelope.description: Operating envelope: parameter ranges over which the reproduction was tested and remained valid.

tested.description: Whether the bound was empirically probed (true) or only declared (false).

failure_modes.description: Conditions under which the reproduction breaks. Each entry MUST cite at least one piece of evidence (trace file or artifact id).

evidence_artifact.description: Artifact id (from execution.artifacts[].id) demonstrating the failure.

evidence_trace.description: Path to a trace file inside bundle that captured the failure.

symptom.description: What goes wrong? (e.g. 'loss diverges at step 200').

sensitivity.description: Parameter sensitivity sweeps — which knobs change which outcomes, and by how much.

outcome_metric.description: Which deviation metric is being tracked.

title: ARM Characterization v1
